subject: Lighthouse MAP & Pricing: proposed checkpoints and ramp incentives
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: James Allen <james.allen@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Lighthouse MAP & Pricing: proposed checkpoints and ramp incentives

Hi Lena / James—

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) outline and an initial pricing view so you can confirm the evaluation milestones and expected ramp timeline. High level:

- 30-day technical POC (canary tests + security review) — checkpoint A
- 90-day seeded evaluation (API traffic + integration tests) — checkpoint B
- 6-month ramp to committed throughput (tranche pricing unlocks) — checkpoint C

Proposed commercial levers:
- Intro pricing for checkpoint A: 20% off list for first 90 days (up to 150K tokens).
- Committed volume tiers starting at checkpoint B; additional discounts applied at checkpoint C based on committed monthly tokens.
- Early-adopter ramp incentive: additional 10% rebate if you exceed the committed baseline by 2x within the first 6 months.

Attached: LF-proposal-v1.pdf (pricing table + MAP timeline).

Can you confirm: (1) the MAP milestones above match your evaluation plan, (2) the target date for checkpoint A (you mentioned "late Sep" — does 9/30 work?), and (3) whether the security questionnaire should be a separate tracked checkpoint?

If that’s all aligned I’ll circulate an internal approval request for the proposed intro discount and the ramp incentive so we can formalize the doc for signature.

Thanks—
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.inference] | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@lighthouse.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: James Allen <james.allen@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lighthouse MAP & Pricing: proposed checkpoints and ramp incentives

Karthik—

Thanks for the clear summary and the draft. A few quick notes from our side:

- Checkpoint timings: we need a bit more runway for the POC. Can we move checkpoint A to 10/10? Our infra lead is out the last week of September.
- Discount: 20% intro is in the right direction but given our expected volume profile we were hoping for 25% on the first 90 days, with the rebate paid out after checkpoint B.
- Security: yes — please add the SOC2/security questionnaire as a tracked MAP checkpoint (we need the evidence before we can promote to production).

James (cc) will own the technical signoff — James, can you flag any red lines on the security deliverables?

If you can update the proposal and the MAP timeline, we can try to route it to procurement the week after checkpoint A.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product | Lighthouse AI
[lena.ortiz@lighthouse.ai]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Lighthouse MAP & Pricing: proposed checkpoints and ramp incentives

Team — forwarding Lena's response. They want: checkpoint A moved to 10/10, and intro discount increased from 20% -> 25% for first 90 days, with rebate payout after checkpoint B. They also want SOC2 proof tracked as a MAP checkpoint.

Requesting quick approvals:
- Approve 25% intro discount for checkpoint A (financial impact: reduces ARR on initial 90 days; see rough calc in line item).
- Approve conditional rebate (10%) to trigger only if monthly usage > 2x committed baseline within first 6 months.

Background: Lighthouse is an early strategic target in retail AI vertical; win here unlocks multiple partner co-selling opportunities. We can ask Legal to add a limited-term clause that restores list pricing if ramp doesn't materialize.

Can I get a signoff today so I can send LF-proposal-v2 and a MAP-checklist (SOC2 node) to the customer Monday?

Thanks—
Karthik

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 at 09:15
Subject: Re: Lighthouse MAP & Pricing: proposed checkpoints and ramp incentives

(Kate, James — quick FYI)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lighthouse MAP & Pricing: proposed checkpoints and ramp incentives

Karthik —

Approve the 25% intro discount for checkpoint A with the following conditions:

1) Add a 6-month minimum retention clause tied to the discounted rate; if the customer terminates or drops below the committed baseline before 6 months, we reserve the right to recoup the discount pro rata.
2) Include an automatic uplift clause: if they exceed 2x the committed baseline we convert the uplift into a billed credit (not a cash refund) applied in the following billing cycle.
3) Legal must review and sign off on the MAP+contract; please loop in Legal early — I recommend Claire H. for SLA language.

Please attach the MAP-checklist.xlsx (security gating items) when you send the updated proposal.

I'll approve the conditional 10% ramp rebate so long as the terms above are added. Good win if we keep cadence tight.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: James Allen <james.allen@lighthouse.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal & MAP checklist (v2) — next steps and signatures

Hi Lena / James —

Thanks for the prompt feedback and James — appreciate you joining the thread. Per internal approvals we have updated the MAP and pricing:

- Checkpoint A moved to 2025-10-10 (POC window).
- Intro discount: 25% off list for first 90 days (applies up to 150K tokens).
- Conditional 10% ramp rebate remains as discussed; triggers only if usage exceeds 2x committed baseline within 6 months and is applied as a billing credit.
- SOC2/security questionnaire added as MAP checkpoint (checkpoint A gated deliverable).
- Added 6-month retention clause tied to the discounted rate; details in LF-proposal-v2.pdf.

Attached: LF-proposal-v2.pdf (updated commercial terms), MAP-checklist.xlsx (security gating items).

Next steps:
1) Review LF-proposal-v2 and MAP-checklist; if OK, sign via the DocuSign link below.
2) Once signed, we’ll set up a kickoff call for 10/06 to align the POC scope and the security evidence collection.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/initiatives/LF-2025-0912
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Let me know if you want legal on the kickoff call. Otherwise I’ll route the DocuSign and aim for signature by 09/03 so we have the necessary lead time.

Thanks—
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
